task.title: Reconcile legacy decision-build lint errors
task.summary: Reconcile pre-trace legacy decision builds that fail decision-table lint rules, or document/defer them with explicit migration triggers.

goal.outcome: Graph health has explicit roadmap coverage for legacy decision-build lint errors and a bounded path to clear or defer them.
acceptance: Active graph-health blockers from legacy decision builds are mapped to scoped remediation evidence or explicitly deferred with deletion triggers.
No historical build artifacts are hand-mutated without validation evidence or approved compatibility policy.
Alignment/generated-parity audits show either fewer uncovered errors or explicit task coverage for remaining legacy drift.
non_goals: Do not migrate all historical artifacts in one sweep unless audit proves it is safe and bounded.
Do not delete legacy build artifacts without archive/restore evidence.
Do not change the v1 lifecycle trace schema from TASK-093.

delta.desired: Legacy decision-build lint errors have scoped remediation/defer coverage and next action can proceed through normal task workflow.
delta.current: Roadmap open 0 but graph-health reports legacy decision-build lint errors with no open roadmap coverage.
delta.closure: Task closes when graph-health reconciliation is validated and remaining legacy drift has explicit coverage.
